question: How many unused PTO days can I carry over into the next year?
answer: You may carry over up to 5 unused PTO days into the next calendar year. If the unused days are due to sickness or parental leave, you may carry over all unused days instead, but those must be used within 12 months of your return to work. [1][2]
gold_answer: Up to 5 days, used by 31 March.

citations.title: Paid Time Off (PTO)
citations.snippet: Carried-over days must be used by 31 March of that year. Any carried-over days not used by 31 March are forfeited.

citations.title: Paid Time Off (PTO)
citations.snippet: These days must be used within 12 months of your return to work. Ask the People team to record the exception in PeopleHub.

question: How much notice do I need to give for a PTO request of more than 3 consecutive days?
answer: You must submit the request at least 2 weeks in advance for absences of more than 3 consecutive working days. [1]
gold_answer: At least 2 weeks.

citations.title: Paid Time Off (PTO)
citations.snippet: For absences of more than 3 consecutive working days, submit the request at least 2 weeks in advance.

question: How many floating holidays do employees get each year?
answer: Employees receive two floating holidays per calendar year. New hires who join after 30 June receive one floating holiday for their first calendar year instead of two. [1][2]
gold_answer: 2 floating holidays per year.

citations.title: Public Holidays
citations.snippet: Each employee receives 2 floating holidays per calendar year. Floating holidays let employees mark religious, cultural or personal days that are not on the company list.

citations.title: Public Holidays
citations.snippet: New employees who join after 30 June receive 1 floating holiday for their first calendar year instead of 2.

question: What compensation do I get if I work on a public holiday?
answer: You receive pay at twice your normal rate for the hours worked and one day off in lieu, which must be taken within 60 days of the holiday worked. [1]
gold_answer: 2x pay for hours worked plus a day off in lieu within 60 days.

citations.title: Public Holidays
citations.snippet: one day off in lieu, which must be taken within 60 days of the holiday worked.

question: How many paid sick days do full-time employees get per year?
answer: Full‑time employees receive 10 days of paid sick leave per calendar year at full pay. [1]
gold_answer: 10 days at full pay.

citations.title: Sick and Family Leave
citations.snippet: Full-time employees receive 10 days of paid sick leave per calendar year at full pay. Part-time employees receive a pro rata amount.

question: When do I need a doctor's note for a sickness absence?
answer: You need a doctor’s note when your sickness absence exceeds 3 consecutive calendar days, and Acme may also request one if you have more than 4 separate sickness periods in a 12‑month span. [1]
gold_answer: For absences of more than 3 consecutive calendar days.

citations.title: Sick and Family Leave
citations.snippet: Acme Corp may also request a doctor's note if an employee has more than 4 separate periods of sickness absence in 12 months.

question: How long is paid parental leave for the primary caregiver?
answer: The primary caregiver is entitled to 16 weeks of paid parental leave. [1]
gold_answer: 16 weeks at full pay.

citations.title: Sick and Family Leave
citations.snippet: The primary caregiver of a new child is entitled to 16 weeks of parental leave at full pay. This may be followed by up to 10 further weeks of unpaid leave.

question: What are the core hours for hybrid and remote employees?
answer: Hybrid and remote employees must be available during core hours of 10:00 to 15:00 in their local time zone. [1]
gold_answer: 10:00 to 15:00 local time, Monday to Friday.

citations.title: Remote and Hybrid Work
citations.snippet: All hybrid and remote employees must be available for meetings and collaboration during core hours, which are 10:00 to 15:00 in the employee's local time zone, Monday to Friday. Outside core hours employees may arrange their working time flexibly, within the 37.5-hour standard working week.

question: How much is the one-time home-office setup stipend?

citations.title: Remote and Hybrid Work
citations.snippet: One-time setup stipend: hybrid and fully remote employees receive a one-time home-office stipend of $500 to buy a desk, chair, monitor or other equipment.

question: What is the per diem for international business travel?
answer: $110 per day. [1]
gold_answer: $110 per day.

citations.title: Travel and Expense
citations.snippet: International travel: $110 per day. On the first and last day of a trip, the per diem is 75% of the daily rate.

question: Above what amount do I need an itemised receipt for an expense?
answer: You need an itemised receipt for any individual expense over $25. [1]
gold_answer: Every individual expense over $25.

citations.title: Travel and Expense
citations.snippet: An itemised receipt is required for every individual expense over $25. Credit card statements alone are not acceptable as receipts.

question: Who needs to approve an expense claim of $3,000?
answer: The claim must be approved by the employee’s manager and then by the department head. [1]
gold_answer: The manager and then the department head.

citations.title: Travel and Expense
citations.snippet: Claims from department heads are approved by the CFO; claims from the CFO are approved by the CEO.

question: What is the minimum length for passwords on Acme Corp accounts?
answer: The minimum length for passwords on Acme Corp accounts is 14 characters. [1]
gold_answer: 14 characters.

citations.title: Information Security
citations.snippet: All passwords for Acme Corp accounts must meet these rules: A minimum length of 14 characters. No reuse of a password across different accounts, and no reuse of any of your last 10 Acme Corp passwords.

question: How soon must I report a security incident?
answer: You must report a security incident within 1 hour of discovering it. [1]
gold_answer: Within 1 hour of discovering it.

citations.title: Information Security
citations.snippet: Report every suspected security incident to the IT Security team within 1 hour of discovering it, by email to security@acme.example or by calling the 24-hour security hotline listed on the intranet.

question: Am I allowed to install a torrent client on my company laptop?
answer: No, you cannot install a torrent client on your company laptop. The policy explicitly lists torrent clients as prohibited software on company devices and requires that only software from the company catalogue be installed, with any other software needing an IT Service Desk ticket and possible security review. [1][2]
gold_answer: No, torrent clients are prohibited software.

citations.title: Acceptable Use of IT
citations.snippet: The following software is prohibited on company devices and must not be used for company work:

citations.title: Acceptable Use of IT
citations.snippet: Only software from the company software catalogue may be installed on company devices. To request software that is not in the catalogue, raise an IT Service Desk ticket.

question: How long are office CCTV recordings kept?
answer: Office CCTV recordings are kept for 30 days. [1]
gold_answer: 30 days from the date of recording.

citations.title: Data Privacy and Retention
citations.snippet: CCTV recordings from offices | 30 days | Date of recording

question: What are the four data classification levels?
answer: Public, Internal, Confidential, and Restricted. [1]
gold_answer: Public, Internal, Confidential and Restricted.

citations.title: Data Privacy and Retention
citations.snippet: Confidential | Restricted to people with a business need. Disclosure could harm Acme Corp, customers or employees. | Customer contracts, financial forecasts, source code, customer personal data.

question: What is the value limit for accepting a gift from a supplier?
answer: The value limit for accepting a gift from a supplier is $50 per gift. [1]
gold_answer: $50 per gift; above that needs Legal approval.

citations.title: Code of Conduct and Anti-Harassment
citations.snippet: The limit is $50 in value per gift. Any gift or hospitality above $50 must be declared to the Legal team and may only be accepted with their approval.

question: How often are performance reviews held?
answer: Performance reviews are held twice a year: a mid‑year review in June and an annual review in December. [1]
gold_answer: Twice a year: mid-year in June and annual in December.

citations.title: Performance Reviews and Promotion
citations.snippet: The mid-year review takes place in June. It is a development-focused conversation and does not include a formal rating.

question: How much is the annual learning and development budget?
answer: The annual learning and development budget is $1,500 per calendar year. [1]
gold_answer: $1,500 per calendar year.

citations.title: Benefits and Wellness
citations.snippet: Each full-time employee has a learning budget of $1,500 per calendar year for courses, conferences, certifications and books related to their current or future role at Acme Corp. To use the budget, request approval from your manager in PeopleHub before booking.

question: How long is the probation period for new employees?
answer: The probation period for new employees is six months. [1]
gold_answer: Six months, extendable once by up to three months.

citations.title: Employee Handbook Overview
citations.snippet: All new employees serve a probation period of six months from their start date. During probation your manager will hold at least three formal check-ins: at the end of month one, month three and month five.

question: Can I use my personal laptop for company work when I work from home?
answer: No. Personal laptops may not be used for company work, even when working from home. This is stated in the Acceptable Use of IT policy, which requires employees to use their company‑issued laptop for all company work and prohibits accessing company systems from personal devices [1][2].
gold_answer: No; personal laptops may not be used for company work; use the company laptop. Personal phones only via the managed app.

citations.title: Acceptable Use of IT
citations.snippet: Personal laptops and computers must not be used for company work and must not be used to access company systems, other than the public careers site and the PeopleHub self-service portal through a web browser. This applies wherever you work, including from home.

citations.title: Remote and Hybrid Work
citations.section: Using Personal Devices When Working Remotely
citations.snippet: A personal laptop may not be used for company work, whether at home or elsewhere; employees must use their company-issued laptop. Personal phones and tablets may be used only for email and chat through the company's managed app, as set out in the Acceptable Use of IT policy (POL-08).

question: Do I have to use the VPN when I work from home?
answer: Yes, you must use the company VPN when working from home. [1] [2]
gold_answer: Yes, always use the company VPN on any non-office network.

citations.title: Information Security
citations.snippet: Use the company VPN whenever you access company systems from any network other than an Acme Corp office network, including home, hotel and public Wi-Fi. The requirements for remote working are summarised in the Remote and Hybrid Work policy (POL-05).

citations.title: Remote and Hybrid Work
citations.snippet: Always connect to company systems through the company VPN when using a network other than an Acme Corp office network.
